findings.issue: `[CompleteSpace X]` is auto-included in every definition (`weakDerivStepSubmodule` l.140, `WeakDerivStep` l.188, `prevL` l.195, `prev` l.200, `derivL` l.215, `deriv` l.220, `mk` l.236) although it is used only by the `CompleteSpace` instance at l.286; the graph submodule and its membership characterization hold for any normed `X`.

summary: The PR proves a full general step API in `WeakDerivStep` but derives nothing from it: only `weakDerivStepSubmodule` and the two `mem_*` lemmas are consumed, while `W2p` and `W3p` each re-prove the projections, constructor, norm bounds, graph-norm identity and completeness for their own order. The generic file also over-assumes `InnerProductSpace ℝ E` and carries `[CompleteSpace X]` on definitions that never use it.
